data.one_liner: A minimalistic framework for managing code and database migrations.
data.what_it_does: Goose provides a platform-agnostic structure for migrating code or databases up and down. It uses a programmable API with zero dependencies to track and execute migrations sequentially.
use_when: You need to run sequential migrations for local databases or app data structures.
You want a zero-dependency migration runner that works across platforms.
avoid_when: You are looking for automatic schema generation or an opinionated ORM migration tool.
You only need simple key-value persistence without migration history.
strengths: Programmable API supporting up and down migrations with state streams
weaknesses: Requires manual implementation of storage and retrieval for migration keys
No built-in database drivers or out-of-the-box persistence adapters
data.setup_notes: Simply add goose to pubspec.yaml and implement your migration logic and key storage functions.
